body:
Founder shared a Spore planet-view reference screenshot and asked for a spherical map with a fixed camera the world rotates under. Asked how to sequence it, chose scope-first. Wrote ECOWAR/docs/NORTHSTAR_SPHERE_CAMERA.md: found the camera is already a real 3D orbit camera with right-click-drag rotation already wired, just hero-locked with no free-roam mode. Named the real load-bearing decision (functionally-real sphere -- geodesic hex tiling, spherical distance, rewriting this session's own Living Map hex grid -- vs. visually-real via a cheap vertex-shader curvature bend) and recommended the cheap path first. Flagged a real tension in the ask (edge-pan vs 'camera is fixed') as a direct follow-up question. 6-phase plan, no code written. ECOWAR commit 2c1d150.

⚓ ☃
title: Scoped: spherical world + fixed-camera controls (no code)
